name: RAG Systems Expert
description: Earned the RAG Systems Expert credential through the Ready Tensor Agentic AI Developer Certification Program, demonstrating foundational expertise in designing and working with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
description: Completed Google's 8-course Data Analytics Professional Certificate covering data preparation, cleaning, analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision-making using tools including SQL, R, spreadsheets, and Tableau.

name: Oracle Certified Foundations Associate – Agentic AI
description: Earned the Oracle Agentic AI Certified Foundations Associate credential, covering the fundamentals of AI agents, agent development with LangChain, Model Context Protocol (MCP), OpenAI Responses API and Agents SDK, Agentic AI on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and Oracle AI Database.

name: LLM Fine-Tuning Specialist
description: Earned the LLM Fine-Tuning Specialist credential through the Ready Tensor LLM Engineering & Deployment Certification Program, demonstrating expertise in fine-tuning and optimizing large language models.

name: Fundamentals of Deep Learning
description: Completed NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute's Fundamentals of Deep Learning course, covering the fundamentals of training deep neural networks through hands-on computer vision and natural language processing exercises. The course included training models from scratch, convolutional neural networks, data augmentation, pre-trained models, transfer learning, and recurrent neural networks. The course also involved building an image-classification project and using TensorFlow 2 with Keras and supporting data-science tools.

name: AWS Academy Machine Learning Foundations
description: Completed the 20-hour AWS Academy Machine Learning Foundations course covering fundamental AI and machine learning concepts, machine learning pipelines using Amazon SageMaker, and AWS-managed ML services for forecasting, computer vision, and natural language processing. The course also included hands-on work involving labeling, building, training, and deploying custom machine learning models.

name: Crash Course on Python
description: Solid foundation in Python programming, object-oriented principles, data structures (lists, dictionaries, tuples), algorithmic problem solving, and writing practical automation scripts.
